name: GitHub Issue Sync
description: Keeps a GitHub issue in step with the task created from it. worktrees.addFromIssue now also creates a root task (title = issue title, description holds the issue URL, worktree = new worktree) carrying the optional `issueNumber` frontmatter field (task-format/store/tasks-server/UI types; serialized only when set). extension/src/issueSync.ts: pure planIssueSync(prevStamps, tasks) diffs {status, phase} per root task with an issueNumber — first sight only primes (no spam), a change yields a `gh issue comment`, reaching done yields `gh issue close --comment` (with the PR URL). registerIssueSync runs it debounced (2 s) from refreshTaskSurfaces; failures are swallowed. Opt-in: codeWorkbench.github.syncIssues (default false) since it writes to GitHub.
guidelines: Keep the diff/plan pure and unit-tested; gh calls are best-effort and never block the board.
Never enable sync by default — it writes to an external service.
anti_patterns: Do not post for tasks seen for the first time (enabling sync must not comment on old issues).
